items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: In fact one of my greatest gigs was with him about two or three years ago.

ctx.x: Okay. He mentions some nice things about you too.

Oh yeah. It’s funny because Leslie Gourse made him come out like Erroll Flynn. He was Joe Williams the lover I think. No it was good through because Joe is a class act. In fact one of my greatest gigs was with him about two or three years ago. He was working at the Skyland Room, what is it, NBC—
